series.name: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)
series.notes: Documented models GW3600-EH, GW5000-EH, GW6000-EH, GW3600N-EH, GW5000N-EH, GW6000N-EH. Same F-prefix visual style as SDT-G3 but the numbering is NOT identical - see CONFLICTS. EH uses F160/F161/F162/F163/F164 for the higher block, SDT-G3 uses F160-F163, and some rows are '-'. Codes here apply to the EH manual only.

meaning.en: No grid power, or the AC line / AC switch is disconnected, so the inverter is not exporting.
meaning.ur: Grid power nahi hai ya AC line / AC switch disconnect hai, is liye inverter export nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Grid power outage.
causes.ur: Grid power chali gayi.

causes.en: AC line or AC switch disconnected.
causes.ur: AC line ya AC switch disconnect hai.

solutions.en: The alarm clears by itself once grid power is restored.
solutions.ur: Grid power aane par alarm khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC line and AC switch for a loose or tripped connection.
solutions.ur: AC line aur AC switch ka dhila ya trip hua connection check karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: PV string or battery port insulation to protective earth is too low; the manual states above 80kOhm is normal.
meaning.ur: PV string ya battery port ka protective earth se insulation bohat kam hai, manual ke mutabiq 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted to protective earth.
causes.ur: PV string protective earth se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Long-term humid environment with poor line-to-ground insulation.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur line-to-ground insulation kamzor hai.

causes.en: Low line-to-ground insulation resistance at the battery port.
causes.ur: Battery port par line-to-ground insulation resistance kam hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator, then measure each string to PE; over 80kOhm is normal.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein, phir har string ko PE se measure karein, 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect strings one by one to isolate the leaking string.
solutions.ur: Strings ko aik aik disconnect karke leaking string ko alag karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter protective earth wire is connected.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka protective earth wire laga hua hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: In genuinely wet conditions only, reset the Insulation Resistance Protection Point in the app.
solutions.ur: Sirf asal mein geelay mahaul mein app se Insulation Resistance Protection Point reset karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: The relay self-test found a problem: relay shorted, relay sampling circuit abnormal, or AC side wiring loose or shorted.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test ne masla paya: relay short hai, relay sampling circuit abnormal hai ya AC side wiring dhili/shorted hai.

causes.en: Relay fault such as a relay short circuit.
causes.ur: Relay short circuit jaisa fault.

causes.en: Relay sampling circuit abnormality.
causes.ur: Relay sampling circuit ki kharabi.

causes.en: AC side wiring abnormal, loose connection or short circuit.
causes.ur: AC side wiring abnormal, dhili connection ya short circuit.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, wait 5 minutes, then re-energise before deeper checks.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

solutions.en: With AC isolated, inspect and re-torque the AC output terminals for a loose conductor.
solutions.ur: AC isolate kar ke AC output terminals ki tightening check karein.

solutions.en: Test the relay contacts for continuity and check the coil voltage on energising.
solutions.ur: Relay contacts ki continuity test karein aur energize hone par coil voltage check karein.

notes.en: On SDT-G3 the same number F32 means 'Inverter Internal Failure', so the two manuals must not be merged.
notes.ur: SDT-G3 par isi number F32 ka matlab 'Inverter Internal Failure' hai, is liye dono manuals merge nahi karne.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: An arc or bad connection was detected on the DC side within strings 1 to 16, usually from a loose or damaged terminal.
meaning.ur: Strings 1 se 16 mein DC side par arc ya kharab connection mila, aam tor par dhile ya damaged terminal ki wajah se.

causes.en: Loose DC side connection terminals.
causes.ur: DC side ke connection terminals dhile hain.

causes.en: Poor contact at the DC side terminals.
causes.ur: DC side terminals par poor contact hai.

causes.en: Damaged DC cable core causing poor contact.
causes.ur: DC cable ka core damaged hai jis se contact kharab hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and confirm the DC arcs are dead before any inspection.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur inspect karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC arcs band hain.

solutions.en: Read the string voltage and current after reconnect; an abnormal drop or zero means the affected string.
solutions.ur: Reconnect karne ke baad string ka voltage aur current dekhein, girtan ya zero ka matlab usi string mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Re-crimp the affected MC4 connector with the correct tool and replace any heat-damaged connector.
solutions.ur: Matlab wali MC4 connector sahi tool se dobara crimp karein aur garmi se kharab connector replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

title.ur: Residual current baar baar trip, band (F52)

meaning.en: North American rules require no automatic recovery after multiple residual current faults, so the unit needs manual recovery or a 24h wait.
meaning.ur: North American rules ke mutabiq baar baar residual current fault ke baad auto recovery nahi hota, is liye manual recovery ya 24 ghante ka intezaar chahiye.

causes.en: Multiple residual current events on the PV string.
causes.ur: PV string par baar baar residual current event hue hain.

causes.en: PV string ground impedance too low.
causes.ur: PV string ka ground impedance bohat kam hai.

solutions.en: Isolate DC and locate the leakage path before attempting a reset.
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle DC isolate karke leakage ka asal rasta dhoondein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string to PE impedance; it must be comfortably above the protection point.
solutions.ur: PV string se PE impedance measure karein, ye protection point se kaafi upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: After the fix, clear the fault per the local utility procedure or allow the 24h wait.
solutions.ur: Theek karne ke baad local utility ke tareeqe se fault clear karein ya 24 ghante ka intezaar dein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: Back-up side load is above the inverter output, so the inverter can no longer sustain the overload.
meaning.ur: Back-up side ka load inverter output se zyada hai, is liye inverter overload nahi sambhal sakta.

causes.en: Back-up load above rated output.
causes.ur: Back-up load rated output se zyada hai.

causes.en: Inductive motor starting current on back-up.
causes.ur: Back-up par motor ka starting current.

solutions.en: Turn off some off-grid loads to reduce the inverter off-grid output power.
solutions.ur: Kuch off-grid loads band karke inverter ki off-grid output power kam karein.

solutions.en: Add up the back-up load in watts and compare with the back-up rated power.
solutions.ur: Back-up load ko watts mein jama karke rated power se compare karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: On the off-grid side the inverter output overvoltage could damage connected loads, so the unit reacted.
meaning.ur: Off-grid side par inverter output overvoltage se loads kharab ho sakte hain, is liye unit ne protect kiya.

causes.en: Caused by load switching.
causes.ur: Load switching ki wajah se hua.

causes.en: Back-up output voltage rise into the load's non-tolerated band.
causes.ur: Back-up output voltage load ki tolerance se upar chala gaya.

solutions.en: If it only happens on load switching, ignore it; it is normal transient behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf load switch karne par aaye to ignore karein, ye normal transient behaviour hai.

solutions.en: Measure the back-up output voltage with an AC meter during the switch-on surge.
solutions.ur: Switch-on surge ke dauran AC meter se back-up output voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If frequent, move surge-heavy loads off back-up and raise the inverter's switching margin.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to surge wale loads back-up se hatayein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: The AC terminal is over temperature, attributed to poor ventilation, high ambient or an abnormal internal fan.
meaning.ur: AC terminal ka temperature zyada hai, wajah poor ventilation, high ambient ya internal fan ki kharabi hai.

causes.en: Inverter installation location lacks ventilation.
causes.ur: Jahan inverter laga hai wahan ventilation kam hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Internal fan operation abnormal.
causes.ur: Internal fan theek nahi chal raha.

solutions.en: Check the ventilation at the installation point and the ambient temperature there.
solutions.ur: Installation jagah ki ventilation aur wahan ka ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Improve airflow around the unit; keep 300mm+ clearance as per the manual.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aas paas airflow behtar karein, manual ke mutabiq 300mm se zyada gap rakhein.

solutions.en: If both are normal, the internal fan is likely at fault - replace it.
solutions.ur: Agar dono normal hain to internal fan kharab hai, use replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

meaning.en: The battery precharge circuit is faulty, commonly a burnt precharge resistor, so the bus never reaches battery voltage.
meaning.ur: Battery precharge circuit kharab hai, aam tor par precharge resistor jal chuka hai, is liye bus battery voltage tak nahi pohanchta.

causes.en: Precharge resistor burnt or precharge circuit fault.
causes.ur: Precharge resistor jal chuka hai ya precharge circuit fault hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage does not match the bus voltage.
causes.ur: Battery voltage bus voltage se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Power the battery on alone with the inverter off and compare battery voltage with the DC bus voltage.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karke sirf battery on karein aur battery voltage se DC bus voltage compare karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the precharge resistor for charring and the battery contactor for pitting.
solutions.ur: Precharge resistor par kaale nishaan aur battery contactor par pitting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the burnt precharge resistor at the same resistance and wattage.
solutions.ur: Jale hue precharge resistor ko usi resistance aur wattage se replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

title.ur: PV access mode ki setting ghalat (F122)

meaning.en: The configured PV access mode (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) does not match the real MPPT wiring, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Set kiya gaya PV access mode (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) asal MPPT wiring se match nahi karta, is liye inverter nahi chalta.

causes.en: Actual PV access mode does not match the device setting.
causes.ur: Asal PV access mode device ki setting se match nahi karta.

causes.en: APP or screen still set to AAAA after an MPPT was split.
causes.ur: MPPT split karne ke baad bhi APP ya screen AAAA par hai.

solutions.en: Write down which PV channels share a string.
solutions.ur: Likh lein ke kaun se PV channels aik hi string share karte hain.

solutions.en: Set the PV access mode in the app or on screen to match, then isolate PV and AC and restart.
solutions.ur: App ya screen par PV access mode usi tarah set karein, phir PV aur AC isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the setting already matches and the code persists, escalate to GoodWe service.
solutions.ur: Agar setting pehle se match karti hai aur phir bhi code aata hai to GoodWe service ko baat karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault
